title: Shared measurement vocabulary

source.citation: Repository definitions of abstract measurement quantities; no empirical mechanism is asserted.

review.note: Vocabulary definitions only; application-specific measurement and acceptability require declarations.

limitations: Shared measurement vocabulary does not establish causation, an effect or a matrix mapping.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Elapsed time over an explicitly selected interval.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Number of explicitly defined items or events in a selected scope.

parameters.name: Fraction
parameters.description: A specified subset count divided by its specified nonzero total count.
